doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line. Hero pairing: not specified in this thread. Playstyle: Charge is a close-up spell, not the main DMG tool like other cav — Charge or X-move in, then press 2. With the recommended doctrine set, the X-move while Sprint is active is insanely strong (core value of the Sprint Extra-Attack + Sword Cavalry Speed combo); without those doctrines, replace with other DMG doctrines. Follow-up post (2025-03-17) attaches a video clip 'Clap-2.mp4', not transcribed. Thread title is 'Ironcap Scouts' (tierlist assigns this to 'Ironcap Scout Cavalry'); thread tags T2/Cavalry. No dedicated Tips & Tricks section beyond the Playstyle bullets (OP gap, not fabricated). 'Filler'/'Don't put' beyond what's listed are literal X placeholders in the OP. Edit timestamp (2026-06-16) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor by 9 days; Ironcap Scout Cavalry is NOT on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so staleAsOfPatch is not forced — noting pre-patch authorship per instructions only.

steps.text: Charge is a close-up spell and not your main way of doing DMG like other cav. Charge or X-move in, then press 2.
With the recommended set of doctrines, the X-move while Sprint is active is insanely strong.
If you don't have the Sprint Extra-Attack + Sword Cavalry Speed combo, replace with other DMG doctrines.
